description: Dependency updates, as for the Workforce hub. Minor, patch, pin and digest updates auto-merge once the required checks pass; majors wait for a human. CI updates are reviewed by hand, because they change what runs on every pull request.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once required checks pass.
One PR per ecosystem for non-major updates.
In-range npm minors only reach the weekly PR if the lockfile is updated for them.
The bundled Postgres is pinned on purpose (.cargo/config.toml); Tauri and its plugins move together.
CI updates change what runs on every pull request: reviewed by hand.
